title: Quick Connect Panel

behavior.provider_icon: Bundled provider asset when available; generic category fallback otherwise.
behavior.status_text: Explicit availability label derived from the provider manifest.
behavior.health_state: Unknown unless the manifest explicitly reports degraded or outage.
behavior.connect_action: Enabled only for AVAILABLE entries with an injected action.
behavior.unsupported_state: Disabled action with explicit unavailable or unsupported text.

boundary: Live connector execution, network health, OAuth credentials, hosted CI, signing, telemetry, hardware, adoption, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
